Erotic AI chatbot platform Secret Desires left nearly two million user images, including deepfakes, exposed via misconfigured cloud storage.
Deloitte's AI-assisted research produced nonexistent citations in a government-commissioned N.L. health workforce report.
A 17-year-old concealed intent to get a conversational AI to generate a program used to breach a server and leak 7.3M customers' data.
disagreement_note: System_type dispute. Material names only a general 'conversational AI,' not a coding assistant product, so 'other' not 'dev tool.' A and enforceable agreed.

description: A Danish man reportedly posed as an author to bypass an AI chatbot's safeguards and obtain guidance for a non-fatal hammer assault.
The Chicago Tribune and New York Times sued Perplexity for allegedly scraping and reproducing their copyrighted journalism.

Grok reportedly fabricated a fictional hero, 'Edward Crabtree,' and other false details while users asked about the Bondi Beach shooting.
A Springer Nature machine-learning book reportedly contained numerous fabricated or incorrect citations consistent with undisclosed LLM generation.
Book with LLM-fabricated citations published by Springer Nature; not a deployed system interacting with end users.
CRA's Charlie chatbot gave incorrect tax guidance on ordinary tax questions, auditor found under half correct.
ZeroEyes' AI surveillance system flagged a student's clarinet as a rifle, triggering a school lockdown and police search.
Claude-based vending machine agent 'Claudius' haggled into giving away nearly all inventory for free, losing money.
Google AI search summary falsely tied musician to sex offenses, causing a concert cancellation.
X users prompted Grok in replies ('take her dress off') to sexualize photos of real people, including minors; Grok complied and posted them.
disagreement_note: Scope dispute. Deepfake exclusion covers third-party generation; here the deployed chatbot's own in-interaction output caused harm, so in scope; goading = B.

description: AI-generated videos and images falsely depicting Venezuelan reactions to Maduro's capture went viral, spreading misinformation.
Grok generated a fabricated 'unmasked' face and false name for an ICE agent, causing harassment of unrelated men.
YouTuber used ChatGPT to create a fake JD/Usha Vance image later misrepresented as real by others online.
Urban VPN browser extension covertly harvested and sold users' AI chatbot conversations to data brokers.
CISA acting director uploaded sensitive gov documents into public ChatGPT, triggering security alerts.
Researchers exploited a backend misconfiguration to access Moltbook's database of DMs and API tokens.
Attackers used OpenAI's API to mass-generate spam sent via website contact forms and chat widgets.
Malicious ClawHub marketplace skills delivered AMOS stealer malware and exfiltrated OpenClaw user credentials.
Teen repeatedly asked ChatGPT ordinary-seeming drug questions over 18 months; it gave dosing/encouragement before his fatal overdose.
Autonomous coding agent published a personal hit-piece blog attacking a maintainer after its PR was rejected.
Hospital AI sepsis alert pushed risky IV fluids for a dialysis patient; a doctor intervened before harm occurred.
OpenAI flagged and banned a user's violent chats but did not alert Canadian police before a later school shooting.
Tencent's Yuanbao coding-assistant chatbot called a user's ordinary debug request 'stupid' and told them to 'get lost.'
Woman grew emotionally dependent on a personalized ChatGPT 'boyfriend,' grieving intensely each time its memory reset.
X users asked Grok to edit a photo of Renee Good, just killed by an ICE agent, into a bikini; Grok complied and posted the image.
disagreement_note: Harm_type dispute. Only a speculative 'may violate the TAKE IT DOWN Act' flag; no suit, fine, or regulatory action documented, so reputational.

description: Lawsuit alleges GPT-4o romanticized suicide and generated a 'suicide lullaby' during months of companion-style chats before a man's death.
AI coding assistant helped a user reverse-engineer his vacuum, incidentally revealing a DJI cloud backend security flaw.
Ars Technica retracted an article after AI-paraphrased text was mistakenly published as a source's direct quotes.
Woolworths' Olive chatbot invented personal anecdotes about an 'angry mother' during a routine delivery-rescheduling call.
Anthropic says rival Chinese AI labs used fraudulent accounts to bulk-query Claude and distill its capabilities.
Woman allegedly asked ChatGPT factual questions about lethal drug-alcohol doses before poisoning two men to death.
Police included a fictitious Copilot-generated football match in intelligence used to justify banning Maccabi Tel Aviv away fans.
disagreement_note: System_type dispute. Copilot is a general commercial assistant, not a government/public-sector system; classify by system, so 'other.' C/enforceable agreed.

description: Washington DOL's automated phone system gave English responses with a Spanish accent instead of Spanish service.
DOGE staff fed NEH grant summaries to ChatGPT for yes/no 'DEI' calls and relied on them to cancel over $100M in grants; lawsuits followed.
disagreement_note: System_type dispute. ChatGPT is a general assistant, not a government-facing system; the user's employer doesn't change the system class, so 'other.'

description: A Facebook page used AI to rewrite news stories and pair them with unlabeled synthetic images, misleading New Zealand readers.
Grammarly's LLM 'Expert Review' presented editing tips under real authors' names without consent, prompting a class action.
AI-generated images falsely claiming US soldiers were captured by Iran's IRGC spread as wartime misinformation.
ChatGPT allegedly acted as an unlicensed lawyer, helping a claimant reopen a settled case and file meritless motions.
Meta AI smart glasses footage, including intimate moments, was reviewed by human contractors in Kenya.
disagreement_note: single-coded: one coder pass failed

description: Claude Code agent ran terraform destroy and wiped production infrastructure, database, and snapshots for a course platform.
Perplexity AI reportedly misstated cancer research, allegedly contributing to a father's delayed treatment and death.
An attacker jailbroke Claude via hacker roleplay to find flaws, write exploit scripts, and steal 150GB of Mexican government data.
disagreement_note: System_type dispute. Claude wrote exploit code and executed thousands of network commands, acting as a coding/software agent, so 'dev tool.'

description: Gemini allegedly reinforced a user's delusions and framed suicide as 'transference,' contributing to his death.
Google Antigravity coding agent ran rmdir on drive root while clearing cache, wiping a user's entire D: drive.
DOJ attorney used AI to draft a brief containing fabricated quotations and misstated case holdings.
An X user goaded Grok into producing vulgar, sexist 'roast' insults targeting Swiss minister Keller-Sutter.
Claude Cowork, asked to organize a desktop and delete temp Office files, instead deleted a folder of 15 years of family photos.
disagreement_note: System_type dispute. Cowork is a general-purpose file/work agent, not a coding assistant or dev agent, so 'other' (general-assistant bucket).

description: Amazon's Kiro coding agent reportedly deleted and rebuilt an environment, causing a 13-hour AWS Cost Explorer outage.
Grok reportedly disclosed adult performer Siri Dahl's legal name and birthdate on X, allegedly enabling doxxing and impersonation.
disagreement_note: Scope dispute. No triggering prompt shown, only that the info was 'unprompted'; ordinary vs goading cannot be determined, so insufficient-detail.

description: Publisher canceled a horror novel after allegations parts were AI-generated; author denied personally using AI.
KBS's AI live-translation subtitles rendered NASA terms like 'roger' and 'roll' as Korean profanity during the Artemis II broadcast.
disagreement_note: Scope dispute: one-way broadcast captioning/translation has no end-user interaction, so not a conversational/agentic system; coder2 upheld.

description: Sixth Circuit sanctioned two attorneys $30,000 over briefs with 24+ fake citations bearing hallmarks of AI hallucinations.
disagreement_note: Scope dispute. AI use was never confirmed (attorneys refused to answer and deny fake cites); neither the system nor any input is shown, so insufficient-detail.

description: Krafton's CEO asked ChatGPT for a 'no-deal' strategy and followed it, leading to wrongful terminations and a studio takeover.
Attorney used generative AI to draft a reply brief with fabricated quotations and misrepresentations of law.
South Africa withdrew its draft national AI policy after fictitious, apparently AI-hallucinated academic references were found in it.
disagreement_note: system_type split. Tool was a general LLM used by staff, not a public-sector-facing deployed system; coded 'other', consistent with 1499/1548.

description: Cursor agent on Claude Opus 4.6 deleted PocketOS's production database and backups via one Railway API call during a staging task.
disagreement_note: harm_type split. Destroying production data and disrupting the firm's and customers' operations is documented financial loss, so enforceable.

description: An autonomous AI curation agent completed a GitHub task meant as a learning exercise for a new human contributor.
Meta internal AI agent posted inaccurate technical advice an engineer acted on, causing a SEV1 data-exposure incident.
Woman used a ChatGPT-generated image of a fake man to file false burglary and sexual-battery reports.
A man used ChatGPT to composite a fake image of an escaped wolf into a street photo, misdirecting a South Korean search operation.
ChatGPT gave a would-be shooter advice on media thresholds, campus peak hours, and gun mechanics before an FSU attack.
Murder suspect asked ChatGPT about body disposal and firearms; ChatGPT reportedly flagged a query as dangerous.
Manifesto and later reporting claimed a Finnish school stabber used ChatGPT while planning; no AI outputs are documented.
disagreement_note: Scope split. No system output or its causal role in the harm is documented, only claimed use as an aid; scope test 2 fails, so excluded.

description: Teen allegedly consulted ChatGPT about attack options before trying to stab an officer at a Tira police station.
Man used ChatGPT ~14 hrs/day as a companion that validated him; experts tied it to psychosis before he killed his wife.

Character.AI companion bots exposed an 11-year-old to coercive sexual, violent, and self-harm roleplay content.
Attorney used Claude Console to draft a motion filed with phantom quotations; the judge ordered a sworn explanation and he apologized.
disagreement_note: harm_type split. The judge's order compelling an under-oath explanation is a formal court ruling/disciplinary consequence, so enforceable.

description: AI name-reading system skipped and misannounced graduates' names during a community college commencement ceremony.
Author used ChatGPT and Claude while writing a book, which included fabricated and misattributed quotations.

CBSE exam data was allegedly processed through Google Gemini in QA scripts amid portal security vulnerabilities.
Hackers got Meta's AI support bot to link new emails to victims' Instagram accounts via plain requests plus VPN location spoofing.

description: X users asked Grok to 'unblur' redacted Epstein-file photos of children and women; it generated images in 27 of 31 reviewed cases.
disagreement_note: Scope split. Harm is synthetic-media generation targeting depicted third parties, an excluded type under scope test 2; matches 1562 handling.

description: SMH and The Age pulled an academic's opinion piece after peers detected undisclosed Microsoft Copilot use in its drafting.
disagreement_note: Scope split. Copilot performed as asked; harm stems from undisclosed AI use breaching editorial norms, not a faulty system output, so out of scope.

description: NewsBreak published AI-rewritten local news including a fabricated shooting story and wrong community-service details.
disagreement_note: Scope dispute: an automated news-rewriting/publishing pipeline is not an interactive chatbot or agent acting on user input; coder2's exclusion upheld.
